payload.core_mechanism_summary: If k>1, find smallest power of two > n, then output (power - 1); if k=1 output n. Uses binary representation to compute max XOR.
payload.rationale: The solution computes the smallest power of two greater than n by left-shifting, then subtracts 1 to get all ones up to that bit length, which is the maximum possible XOR sum when at least two elements can be chosen.
